newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia allocates 3.5 mln barrels of Dec LSWR.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia allocates 3.5 mln barrels of Dec LSWR.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company, Pertamina has allocated a total of 3.5 million barrels of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for loading in December, industry sources said on Wednesday.
They said British Petroleum has been allotted 1.1 million barrels out of the total allocation.
The December allocation was 100,000 barrels more than the 3.6 million barrels in November.
Sources said Pertamina has yet to release the full details of its loading schedule for its December allocation.
